title: Implement offline alpha-score-v1 judgment engine
objective: Implement alpha-score-v1 as a pure, versioned module over fixture wallet/position inputs: regime-relative robust-z, four factor groups, EWM half-life 14d, live percentile tiers, insufficient≠N, provisional confidence cap for borrowed PnL, anti-gaming penalties (luck/supertoken/cluster/bot), dual rule_version axes. No live data.
forbidden_actions: Do not use network, credentials or live providers.
Do not treat bare token transfers as PnL (swap/venue evidence only).
Do not assign tier N when evidence is insufficient (use status insufficient).
Do not let borrowed-only labels set the tier without excess-return evidence.
Do not lower the 0.85 cluster exclusion gate or modify funding-clusters rule semantics.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood.
